theme.description: Dark hero sections (Obsidian Black) with light content sections (Bone White). High contrast, editorial style.

rules: Headings MUST use tight letter spacing (tracking-tighter) and leading-none.
Never center text by default; use left alignment for strong editorial structure.
Use fluid text sizes for headings up to text-6xl (maximum).
Do not use generic fonts like Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings.

layouts.hero: Dark background, full-height (min-h-screen), kinetic typography with masked line-by-line reveal on load, overlaid on a dark-dimmed solar farm photography.
layouts.services_grid: Bento-style asymmetrical grid. Mixing real photography with solid colored cards. Use raw HTML/Tailwind for creative layouts instead of rigid Shadcn cards.
layouts.stats_section: High density, large typography for numbers, thin mono font for labels. Dark theme to add weight.
layouts.manifesto: Numbered editorial chapters with wide margins, large typography, and generous negative space (py-24 to py-32).
layouts.marquee: Slow editorial marquee, 'Electric Ochre' background or pale background with dark earthy text, mono or serif font, massive gaps between items.
layouts.spacing: Use generous spacing (py-24, py-32) between sections. Containers with border must have internal padding (p-6, p-8). Images must not exceed 80vh on mobile.

rules: Smooth momentum scrolling using Lenis is MANDATORY.
Masked line-by-line text reveal on initial load using framer-motion.
One subtle parallax or 3D hero moment.
Micro-interactions on buttons and cards (slight scale and color shift).
Use raw div/section/span for creative layouts.
ALWAYS use Shadcn for interactive logic (Forms, Inputs, etc.) but strip the default Vercel-look to match the brand.

images.description: Aerial view of a vast solar farm at sunrise.
Man on a roof installing solar panels.
High-angle drone shot capturing a grid of solar panels.
Industrial energy storage facility and solar panels.
Modern skyscraper with glass facade reflecting the sky.

general_ui_ux_design_guidelines: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters where appropriate.
CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it. Example: Dropdown with transparent background.
DO NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements.
DO NOT center align the app container. No .App { text-align: center; }.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
NEVER use placeholder text for images.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
specific_instructions_for_main_agent: Build a multi-page routing structure (Home, About, Services, Experience, Contact). Use react-router-dom.
Implement Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling across the app.
Create a large kinetic hero with masked line-by-line reveal on load.
Include numbered manifesto chapters with editorial styling.
Add one slow editorial marquee using react-fast-marquee.
Implement framer-motion scroll reveals (useInView/useScroll) and micro-interactions.
Showcase licenses & credentials (EPRA C1/V1/V2, A1, T3 Solar PV Technician, EBK) prominently.
Create a large stats section (20 MWp Solar PV, 10 MWh BESS, decades of experience).
Build an asymmetrical services grid (EPC, Construction, Design, Consultancy).
Create a contact form using Shadcn components that saves to a mocked database (console log or mocked API).
Ensure the design feels like an award-winning Awwwards site (Site-of-the-Day level) — elite, professional, sleek.
Use .js/.jsx extensions for all files, DO NOT use TypeScript (.tsx/.ts).
